fields.label: Card key
fields.description: Short id, letters/digits/_/- (becomes the pack id)

fields.label: Blank template
fields.description: Flat, straight-on blank page. Stored private.

fields.label: Grid
fields.description: Row/column lines on the template (cardpack grid.json)

fields.label: Blank card estimate
fields.description: The card with nothing written on it: the pixel median of up to 25 aligned scans. Printed marks it shows are not counted as writing.

fields.label: Template layout
fields.description: The cells found on the template, as the template editor left them (rectangles with name and kind). The grid is derived from this.

fields.label: Grid options
fields.description: Axis, label columns to skip, data columns to keep, heading rows to skip, rows to keep: what the saved grid was made with.

fields.label: Template version in use
fields.description: The newest template version that has a grid: new scans are cut with it.

fields.label: Dates usually written on the same day
fields.description: Comma-separated field keys, for example bcg, penta, opv, pcv, ipv. In one visit, when at least two of them read the same date, a cell reading something else gets that date as a suggestion. Nothing is changed for you.

fields.label: Dates that must go up from visit to visit
fields.description: Comma-separated field keys, for example visit_date. A date earlier than the one before it gets a note.
